title: Ovos crocantes com queijo e sementes
creator: paolacarosella
statusNote: The creator doesn't give amounts. The ≈ amounts are estimates from the video.

items.note: "an obscene amount", she says a third would do

steps: Heat a generous amount of olive oil in a frying pan and scatter in the cheese shavings and the seeds.
Crack the eggs on top and season with salt.
Cover and cook until the whites are just set.
Uncover, turn the heat to maximum and fry until the cheese, whites and seeds form a golden, crunchy crust.
Finish with black pepper if you like and serve.
